children: peaqOS launches on Solana, letting machines activate under peaq Economics 2.0 directly on the network, bond PEAQ, and run the full peaqOS stack. With the deployment, machine financing and monetization become available on Solana, extending peaq's machine economy tooling to Solana's user base and liquidity.

The mechanism to watch is bonding. Machines activating on Solana bond PEAQ, and half of the bonded amount is burned on exit, so Solana-side activations create a direct demand and burn channel for PEAQ tied to Solana's liquidity and user base.
Solana-side machine activations are the metric to track going forward, since they drive PEAQ bonding and burn volume under this deployment.
Robots and machines can now activate directly on Solana, bond PEAQ, and run peaqOS
Machine financing and monetization are now possible in the home of high speed, low latency and deep liquidity
Internet Capital Markets, meet the Machine Economy…

title: peaq: peaqOS launches on Solana with machine activation under Economics 2.0 - 17 Sep 2026
